name: molten_core
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 409 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json), prepped in task B1 (TortoiseBots-audit RAID-PREP-mc) from the world DB (2026-09-12 dump + the Turtle MC updates 20260510092659, 20260517045535, 20260707174014), the core's src/scripts/dungeons/molten_core and the server's map 409 navmesh. Not mapped, not live-checked: the GM-invisible mapping walk (B2) and the first live run are still to do; dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.

Packs: the draft's 104 groups (255 trash spawns) become 98 pulls (70 trash + 28 patrol) and 235 units after B1: the 28 patrol pulls are 11 Lava Surger 12101, 15 Ancient Core Hound 11673, one Shadowforge Guardian 52150 and one Shadowforge Hierophant 52151, each with its path; one Ancient Core Hound (guid 56847) on Ragnaros' one-way chamber ledge is in no pull. Boss adds are the boss rows' `first` (Lucifron 12119 x2, Gehennas 11661 x2, Garr 12099 x8, Sulfuron 11662 x4) or the boss fight's own (Golemagg 11672 x2, which cannot die first). Magmalash Scorpid 62750 is in no pull: he stands in a cave at 1071.401 -1160.986 -233.636 with no normal path to or from any point of the plan.

Merge rule: groups of one leg that stand on one floor (|dz| <= 4) and chain within 15 yd, up to 16 units (L22, 40-man); a group over 16 was split along its own chains (the 30-Imp group became two). Radius = the farther member from the centre + 0.5 yd, cut short of a non-member where the pack's spread allows it, at most 35 (the largest is 20.5). The path rule of the LKH prep (a chained pair's walk at most 2.2 x its distance + 8 yd) removed none here: all four 15 yd group chains are short walks. A pull-reach closure moved 84 spawns between packs.

Boss order: the draft's clear order, with Incindis' Lair after the twin golems and Majordomo Executus + Ragnaros as the last two fights, and Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan's unreachable room last of all (see its leg note). The Turtle guide's order starts with Incindis and has no Gehennas; the world DB keeps Gehennas, and the guide order is a player route, not a script condition.

Events: every rune is a `use_object` step after its boss (GOHello_go_rune_MC: each rune checks its boss DONE, deletes its Circle object and sets its TypeRuneActiveN); the seventh summons Majordomo. The Majordomo fight is a boss step; after it a `wait_for` unit 12018 and three `gossip` steps (option 0, by the tank) on the friendly Domo at 847.103 -816.153 -229.775 run the dialogue that summons Ragnaros (boss_majordomo_executus.cpp GossipSelect_event_domo, DomoEvent case 28). `wait_for` with a unit has no run-leader row (the exporter warns): the gossip retries until the Domo is there.

Approach points: every pull after the first of a leg and every boss carries a stand 12-30 yd from it, on its floor, reached by a normal server path from the point before it; each leg's `to` is its first pull's stand. plan-check: see the prep report.

Attunement: the core's entrance trigger 2886 ('You must be part of a Raid group and at least level 50 to enter') has required_condition 0; the window entrances 3528/3529 do carry the attunement condition (7487). The plan uses 2886, so a 60 raid group needs no attunement item in this core; the commander stands on the landing 1091.89 -466.985 -105.084.

Doors and objects: map 409's 61 game objects are 40 Dark Iron Deposit nodes, the 7 boss runes (176951-176957) and their 7 Circle objects (178187-178193), a Lava Crack, Hot Coal x2, Cache of the Firelord 179703, Core Fragment 179553 and doodads. No door, lever or key gates the route; the runes are the only scripted objects (go_rune_MC).

legs.name: lucifron
notes: The entrance and Lucifron's room: 16 pulls, 74 units (the closure moved the imp block's neighbours here). The two Flamewaker Protectors 12119 are the boss row's `first`: they are Lucifron's creature_group (leader guid 56605), not trash.

Lucifron is a patrol in the world data (creature guid 56605, movement type 2, 39 points, 271 yd, about 108 s); the boss row stands at his spawn 1024.41 -973.309 -181.505, so a run catches him on his loop only when he is near it. B2 must watch this.

legs.name: magmadar
notes: Two pulls before Magmadar (10 units): the Core Hound 11671 packs. Golemagg's two Core Ragers 11672 are a different entry and stay in his fight.
Rune of Kress 176956 (1132.11 -1017.27 -186.49): using it sets TypeRuneActive5 only when Magmadar is DONE (instance_molten_core.cpp GOHello_go_rune_MC).

legs.name: gehennas
notes: 25 pulls. Gehennas is in the world data (12259 at 898.074 -545.87 -203.405, creature_group leader guid 56737 with two Flamewaker 11661): the Turtle guide says 1.18 removed him, the world DB and boss_gehennas.cpp keep him, so the plan keeps his leg. If live MC has no Gehennas, this leg's boss step waits out.
Rune of Mohn 176957 after Gehennas.

legs.name: garr
notes: 9 pulls; Garr's eight Firesworn 12099 are his creature_group (leader 56609) and the boss row's `first`, so they are not trash: they explode when they die (mob_fireswornAI JustDied, 4k fire) and the guide warns not to stand near them.
Rune of Blaz 176955 after Garr.

legs.name: shazzrah
notes: 2 pulls. Rune of Mazj 176953 after Shazzrah.
Shazzrah's Arcane Explosion 19712 is a 3 s cast (spell_template castingTimeIndex 3, interruptFlags 15) and the bot AI already pushes ranged out to 26 yd (ShazzrahMoveAwayAction).

legs.name: baron_geddon
notes: 8 pulls. Geddon is a patrol (guid 56655, 16 points, 471 yd); his room's Lava Surges are their own patrol packs.

The Rune of Zeth belongs to Geddon (TypeRuneActive1) but stands in Golemagg's room at 748.84 -985.16 -178.28, so it is doused in the Golemagg leg: Geddon is dead by then and the run would otherwise walk back and forth.

legs.name: sulfuron_harbinger
notes: 9 pulls; Sulfuron's four Flamewaker Priests 11662 are his creature_group (leader 56677) and the boss row's `first`. Their Dark Mending 19775 is a 5 s cast (spell_template castingTimeIndex 5, interruptFlags 15).
Rune of Koro 176951 after Sulfuron.

legs.name: golemagg_the_incinerator
notes: 6 pulls. Golemagg's two Core Ragers 11672 (creature_group leader 56684) must not be killed first: they cannot die while Golemagg lives (mob_core_ragerAI DamageTaken keeps them at 1 hp and revives them at 50 %, and they die when he does). They stay out of the boss row's `first` and the bot AI's Golemagg camps handle them.

Rune of Theri 176954 and Rune of Zeth 176952 (Geddon's) after Golemagg: the two last runes, so Majordomo Executus is summoned at 758.089 -1176.71 -118.640 right here (instance_molten_core.cpp GOHello, the seventh rune sets TypeDomoSpawn).

legs.name: basalthar
notes: Two pulls (the twin golems' room). Basalthar 65020 and Smoldaris 65021 are both bosses: the boss row is Basalthar with `first` Smoldaris. Damage to one is taken from the other (boss_twin_golemAI DamageTaken) and one death kills the other (JustDied), so the order matters less than keeping them apart.

legs.name: incindis
notes: Four pulls in Incindis' Lair (Turtle's 1.18 area, x 1250-1450). Incindis 52145 summons a large and two small eggs at 50 % health (boss_incindis.cpp), each hatching a Spawn of Incindis 52148; the plan leaves the eggs to the bots' own targeting (no step kind for them).

legs.name: majordomo_executus
notes: Majordomo Executus 12018 has no creature spawn row: the seventh rune douse summons him at 758.089 -1176.71 -118.640 (instance_molten_core.cpp GOHello_go_rune_MC). His eight adds (11663 healers, 11664 elites) are summoned by his script at the eight points in boss_majordomo_executus.cpp.

After the fight he turns friendly at 35 % and, when he stands within 2 yd of 758.089 -1176.71 for 28 s, teleports himself to Ragnaros' chamber (DomoTP at 847.103 -816.153 -229.775). The next leg waits for that Domo.

legs.name: ragnaros

gossip.fail_text: Majordomo's dialogue did not start Ragnaros: his gossip has three options in a row (GOSSIP_ACTION_INFO_DEF + 1, +2, +3), and this is option 1; the friendly Domo teleports here 28 s after his fight.
Majordomo's dialogue did not start Ragnaros: his gossip has three options in a row (GOSSIP_ACTION_INFO_DEF + 1, +2, +3), and this is option 2; the friendly Domo teleports here 28 s after his fight.
Majordomo's dialogue did not start Ragnaros: his gossip has three options in a row (GOSSIP_ACTION_INFO_DEF + 1, +2, +3), and this is option 3; the friendly Domo teleports here 28 s after his fight.

notes: Ragnaros has no creature spawn row: the three gossip options on the friendly Majordomo in his chamber (boss_majordomo_executus.cpp GossipSelect_event_domo, GOSSIP_ACTION_INFO_DEF + 1, +2, +3) run the dialogue and summon Ragnaros at 842.237 -833.683 -231.916 after 28 s (DomoEvent case 28).

The chamber is entered from Shazzrah's side of the map (ServerPath rag_domo -> Shazzrah is the only normal path; from Domo's platform the direct walk ends at 913 -916 -183), hence the via at Shazzrah. Ragnaros stands on the lava: his position's mesh floor is slime (Flags 4), the approach 842.627 -831.721 -231.636 is ground 2 yd away.

legs.name: sorcerer-thane_thaurissan
notes: 12 pulls in Old Shadowforge (Turtle's 1.18 area) and the boss 57642 at 989.268 -1339.37 -196.729. BLOCKER: no server path reaches the boss room from anywhere on the map 409 mesh; every path stops at 1036 -1275 -195 (64 yd short) and the mesh ray from there to the boss is blocked after 0.3 yd. The leg is last so a run reaches Ragnaros before it stops here; B2 must find the real entrance (a ramp the mesh lacks, a gap, or a missing tile). The boss approach is the reachable end.
